close_reason: Moved scope to workspace bead JMAP-w4jf. The bead's title was misleading: maxChanges=0 is NOT silently treated as None — the code correctly rejects 0 with invalidArguments per RFC 8620 §5.2. The actual issue the description names is code duplication between jmap-metadata-server::handle_metadata_changes and the canonical jmap-server::handle_changes maxChanges parser. That is a workspace-canonical refactor (extract a shared parser in jmap-server, use it from extension-server pre-delegate paths), not a metadata-server-local fix. Tracking under JMAP-w4jf as P2 with the full sibling-audit scope. The current per-crate duplication has low actual drift risk because no maxChanges-shape changes land without workspace review.
title: MaxChanges == 0 silently treated as None — semantic ambiguity between 'no cap' and 'reject everything'
